title: POV: someone put it back empty

scenes.label: PUT BACK EMPTY 😤
beats: 0.00 front, frame 1 already mid-action: door open, he has just ripped open the ORANGE JUICE carton and a huge beige DUST CLOUD (about 20 puffs, 0.3 m wide) explodes at his face, a moth flaps out of the carton straight at his nose; sfx loud 'FWOOMP' dust burst + moth flutter; music 'sneak' starts
0.25 he is blown back one step (yaw -0.3, back ease), eyes squeezed, mouth open, coughing (cough sfx x2, 0.25 s apart), both hands flap at the cloud; the moth loops around his head
0.70 he holds the carton upside down and shakes it over his open mouth: nothing falls, a last tiny puff; hollow 'tok'
0.90 CUT ftalk: fridge face visible, flat stare; 'Somebody put it back EMPTY.' subtitles 'Somebody put it' / 'back EMPTY.'
1.80 CUT three: wide, he slaps the empty juice carton back onto the shelf in disgust (thunk), the moth lands on the fridge door; music 'tension' at 2.0

scenes.label: INSTANT REPLAY 📺
beats: 0.00 yog: the bare shelf with the empty orange juice carton standing alone; the student leans in with arms crossed; sfx low sting

0.30 a VAR SCREEN pops up on the back wall of the fridge (back ease, TV 'bwomp' sfx): a framed 'REPLAY' screen with a rewinding scrub bar (rewind whirr, soft); the screen shows a ghostly translucent white-grey figure labelled 'SAM' sneaking in and putting the empty carton back
0.60 the ghost Sam tiptoes in from the right, sets the carton down, looks to the camera and shrugs; the real student's mouth drops open

0.90 CUT fwide: fridge face + the VAR screen in one frame; a referee WHISTLE blast (sfx, short, not shrill, low-passed) and the replay freezes on the ghost's guilty shrug with a green circle drawn around the carton

1.10 fridge (dry, referee voice): 'Replay shows... Sam. Red card.' subtitles 'Replay shows...' / 'Sam. Red card.'; the student points at the screen, then at the carton; music 'yuck' (muted trombone) at 1.0

2.60 CUT ftalk: a big RED CARD on a short stick rises from behind the open fridge door beside the face (pop-up, back ease, whistle sfx x2) reading SAM in white; the fridge stares smugly; the student claps once slowly

scenes.label:
POV: YOUR HOUSEMATE
PUTS EMPTIES BACK
beats: 0.00 fstare close-up: fridge leans into the lens (zoom sfx); the red SAM card still waves beside it
0.10 'Hey, you. Your housemate does this too.' subtitles 'Hey, you.' / 'Your housemate' / 'does this too.'; music 'hit' (dry stab) at 0.0

scenes.label: SHARED HOME 🏠 FRIDGEROO
scenes.notif: Sam set Juice to EMPTY · added to list ✅
beats: 0.00 phone: he holds the phone; the shared-home app shows the Juice fill-level slider at 100% and a small 'Sam' avatar chip (mint circle, white S)
0.35 phonezoom: Sam's slider slides from full to EMPTY (0.35-1.1), the bar drains and turns red, sfx soft slide + tick
1.10 slider hits 0 with a thunk; the juice row pulses red 'Sam: EMPTY ✅'
1.15 notif drops in 'Sam set Juice to EMPTY · added to list ✅' (soft pop); the app stays on screen until 2.3 (2.3 s total with the zoom), so the viewer sees you get warned, not surprised
2.30 CUT ftalk: sunglasses drop at 2.5 (swish + click); fridge: 'Now you know before breakfast.' (grudging, warm); magic glow 2.3 (sparkle sfx), music 'glow'
3.10 sky of fridges ('drop'), chip 'NO MORE EMPTY SURPRISES' 3.1-4.1; pullout at 4.1

caption: Fridgeroo's shared home shows the moment a housemate sets the juice to empty and puts it on your shopping list. 🧃 Use it or lose it. Free at fridgeroo.netlify.app – who in YOUR house puts empties back?

todo.voiceText: [flat, exasperated] Somebody put it back EMPTY. [long pause] [dry, referee] Replay shows... Sam. Red card. [long pause] [deadpan, serious] Hey, you. Your housemate does this too. [long pause] [grudging, warm] Now you know before breakfast.
newProps: JUICE carton (key item, no milk anywhere): orange #ff9f1c box 0.1x0.18x0.07, white gable top that can be ripped open (rotate top flap 70 deg), white label with an orange-slice icon; item('juice', 0.18,0.57,0.12); empty carton leans slightly. Best camera: front / yog.

DUST CLOUD: ~20 beige #e9d9b8 spheres r0.03-0.06 (reuse the stink[] pool, recolour, extend count) bursting from the carton opening toward the camera and student's face over 0.5 s, fading by 0.9 s; plus a soft pale #f4ecd8 additive plane for volume. Best camera: front.

MOTH: grey-brown #8a7a6a body box 0.02x0.02x0.06, two flat wings (boxes 0.07x0.005x0.05) flapping +-0.6 rad at 14 Hz, loops around the student's head 0.0-1.2 s, then lands on the fridge door (wings folded); hidden by default.

VAR SCREEN: dark frame box 0.62x0.42x0.03 (#222) with a lit panel 0.56x0.36 (canvas texture: 'REPLAY' tag top-left, scrub bar bottom with a moving playhead, 'SAM' caption), mounted on the fridge back wall at fridge-local (0,1.25,-0.28), hidden by default (scale 0.001), pops in with back ease. No blue: panel background dark grey #2a2a2a, accents mint #3DDC97 and white.

GHOST SAM (inside the screen): a small blocky figure (head 0.06 cube, body 0.07x0.1x0.04, 2 stub legs) in translucent white-grey #e6e6e6 opacity 0.55, parented to the screen; tiptoes in from the right, sets down a tiny orange carton, shrugs. Hidden by default.
GREEN CIRCLE: thin torus r0.05 mint #3DDC97 that draws around the carton in the replay at freeze time (scale in 0.2 s).
REFEREE WHISTLE: no geometry; sfx only (short low-passed whistle blast, about 0.35 s, no shrill highs).

RED CARD: box 0.16x0.22x0.01 in red #e0262d with a big white 'SAM' (canvas texture, bold) on a 0.02x0.2x0.02 grey stick; pivots up from behind the fridge door's edge next to the face at cardAt (back ease 0.25 s, small wave); hidden by default. Must not cover the fridge face. Best camera: ftalk / fstare.
BARE FRIDGE flag (plan bareFridge:true): hide every IT item except the juice so the replay and the carton read.

APP: drawApp optional P.scenes[i].appSlider={item,from,to,who}: replaces the fridge icon block (y 52-164) with a rounded track 180x16 at y 108, a round thumb moving from full (mint) to empty (#ff6b5a) between `from` and `to` s of the scene, a big % label, the carton emoji at the left, and a mint avatar circle with the first letter of `who` (S) at the right; row 0 then flashes.
newActs: dustburst (new ACT entry): effect already in progress at frame 1 (start internal time at t-0.1). Student at the open fridge, juice carton at face height (s.burstItem); dust cloud + moth appear instantly; yaw -0.3 with back ease 0.25 s, disgust 1, coughs at t+0.3 and t+0.55 (small head jerks), hands flap; at t+0.7 carton shaken upside down (tok); at t+1.8 slapped back onto the shelf (thunk). sfx: FWOOMP dust (low-passed noise burst, no harsh hiss), moth flutter (soft ticks), 2 coughs, hollow tok, thunk.

varreplay (new ACT entry): replayAt (default 0.3): VAR screen pops in (back ease 0.25 s, 'bwomp'), rewind whirr 0.3 s, ghost Sam tiptoes in 0.6 s, sets the carton, shrugs; at t+0.9 whistle blast, replay freezes, green circle draws round the carton; student points at the screen (t+1.1) then the carton (t+1.5); at cardAt (default 2.6) the red card rises with 2 whistle blasts, student claps once slowly. The card stays up through the stare scene (carry via a scene flag cardStays:true, or re-trigger at stare t+0).
phone scene extras: appSlider timing as in plan; notif text is the exact feature message.
judgeNotes: Different from the 6 Nov line-up on purpose: no police, no tape, no numbered tags, no siren emoji, and the key item is orange juice, not milk. Sports-referee / VAR gag only.

Hook with sound off: frame 1 = dust cloud blasting at his face and a moth flying out of the juice carton, 0:01 coughing/flailing, 0:02 fridge face + 'EMPTY', 0:03 the VAR screen pops up. Check the dust does not hide his face for more than 0.4 s and is not grey/ugly in clay look.

Ghost Sam is a simple translucent figure on the screen (not a second full character); if it looks muddy in clay look, replace it with a silhouette cut-out in solid #cfcfcf. The replay must be readable at phone size: carton and ghost >= 40% of the screen height.
Red card must not cover the fridge face; check ftalk at 2.6-3.6 s and fstare.
App PREVENTS the surprise: shared home + fill slider, notif 'Sam set Juice to EMPTY · added to list ✅'. App on screen 2.3 s.
No blue anywhere (brand rule: no blue+yellow); orange carton, red card, mint accents.
Re-render gold preview frames after adding props (playbook section 7): ONLY=0.4,4.0,6.6,8.0,10.5
Re-time durs to the real voice (target total 15.7 s; talk time about 7.5 s).

Judge 1 final (3 Nov): scene-0 label changed from 'BREAKFAST? NOPE.' to 'PUT BACK EMPTY' so the problem is named at 0:01 with sound off; cover time fixed (the card rises at 5.2 s, so 4.6 s showed no card).
